title: Nirdosha menus.toml register (v1)
description: Schema for the menus side of a generated app's register pair (screens.toml + menus.toml). Cross-file invariants between the two files are enforced by `cargo nirdosha generate-screens` at generation time — see docs/MENUS_SCHEMA.md for the invariant list (V1, V2, V3, V5-lite, V6-lite, V8-lite).

screens_source.description: Provenance pointer to the sibling screens.toml (informational today).

landing.description: Post-login landing route per human role. V8-lite: every key must be a role some built screen declares, and every value must be a served route that role may reach.

additionalProperties.description: The route_path (codegen.route_path) of the target screen.

group.description: Nav group ordering blocks. Chrome only — the app-shell macro owns ordering; the generator validates entries, not groups.

menu.description: Nav entries. Each entry is a promise: the generated app serves the referenced screen at the stated route, for the stated roles, gated by a policy the generator synthesizes.

screen_id.description: Must reference a [[screen]] id in screens.toml (V1) whose stage is "built" (V3).

route.description: Must equal the target screen's codegen.route_path (route-agreement) and be unique across entries (V6-lite).

guard.description: V5-lite: (resource, action) must resolve to a synthesized policy record; forbidden on presentational screens (static_embed / login / app_shell).

action.description: Guard action (read, create, update, aggregate, ...). Must appear in some screen's policy.allowed_actions for the resource.

resource.description: Entity name; matched case-insensitively against data_binding.entities.

roles.description: V2: must be a subset of the target screen's declared role names (role part of "Role:R/W" strings).
